description.value:
A velstrac eye set in place of the bearer's own. It is theirs now, and permanent.

The dark holds no secrets (the gift). You gain greater darkvision — you see in darkness, and even in magical gloom, as clearly as in light. You ignore the concealed condition that darkness, dim light, and shadow would impose: no creature gains cover-of-sight against you in the gloom, in this fight or any after. In the finale you see Veyrin even when he melts into shadow and can point the party straight at him — he can never use the gloom to hide from the one who carries the eye.

Revealing Light 1 (finale). During the battle with Veyrin you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} as a single action — the stolen eye drags the light to wherever he hides.

The eye and the reflection (the cost). Your own eye is gone, and your reflection with it — no glass or water ever shows you again.

The light is agony (the cost that bites). The fiend-eye drinks the dark and recoils from the sun. While you stand in natural daylight you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} — everything is concealed to you, a DC 5 flat check to target anything by sight. The dark is yours; step into the sun and the gift turns against you. (Only true daylight bites — not torches, magical light, or the restored light when the Glass breaks.)
